title: Survey: 53% of Americans fear AI could put someone in their household out of work; Democrats are more likely than Republicans to worry about AI's impact on jobs (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Survey: 53% of Americans fear AI could put someone in their household out of work; Democrats are more likely than Republicans to worry about AI's impact on jobs — Half of Americans fear that the rise of AI could put them or someone in their household out of work, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll …
